title: Patched Parchment
summary: Reading unlocks a Bernard dialogue response that earns a Potion of Greater Healing.

fields.Use: Read the parchment and choose its prompt when speaking to Bernard.
fields.Acquisition: Fourth floor of the Arcane Tower, on the desk at X −30, Y −288.
fields.Base value: 14 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
